verdict.rationale: Pilot is a bookkeeping, tax and CFO service with a customer portal, so a public API is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no documented public API. Its integrations (Bill.com, Stripe, Gusto, banks) pull data into Pilot rather than letting users drive the product. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the llms.txt describes only the entity, not an API.
